$comment: Maggioli SVG sources that intentionally (or not yet) have no entry in dictionary.json.
They are still usable through <mds-icon>, which reads svg-icons/dist directly,
but they are NOT part of the @maggioli-design-system/icons font.
scripts/check-dictionary.ts fails on any unmapped source that is not listed here,
so this file is the explicit record of the backlog: shrink it, do not grow it.
'judge-hammer' is a name collision: the dictionary key 'judge-hammer' already
points to mdi/gavel, so the Maggioli source needs a different key to be mapped.
